- Placebo arm: 60 of 240 participants met the threshold (E2, E4), giving a responder rate of 25% (60/240). (Note: one panelist erroneously calculated 60/240 as 18%).

Subtracting the placebo rate from the peloxatril rate (40% − 25%) yields an absolute difference of 15 percentage points.
